name: Phase Oscillator
author: Eric Gao
description: Casio CZ phase distortion: a drive curve then a shape, in series, each crossfaded across a bank. The shape bank is the CZ waveform set including all three resonant windows, which run a formant over a falling envelope.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Scans the drive bank: square, warp, double warp, triple warp. Smooth curves on the ramp, applied first.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Scans the CZ waveform set: saw, pulse, double sine, then the resonant saw, triangle and trapezoid windows.

controls.label: Depth
controls.description: Depth of the whole chain, and the only bypass. Fully down is a plain sine whatever the banks are set to.

controls.label: Formant
controls.description: Ratio of the formant to the fundamental, for the three resonant shapes only. Neutral at centre; ignore it otherwise.

outputs.aux: The same read an octave up, under the same window
